hero.heading: A&A Custom Automation, a cost model sent for correction
hero.caption: Built September 27, 2026, from aacustomautomation.com, the company's posts, and federal data. Every number is labeled: published, federal, or our assumption. The assumptions are sliders; move them and the number moves.
hero.liveCaption: The model's estimate, on the assumptions you have set below
hero.subline: Exact computed endpoints: $32,641.67 and $228,050.00, rounded to the nearest $5,000 for display.

model.heading: Move our assumptions
model.intro: Each slider is one of the assumptions in our letter, set to the range we wrote down. If you know a figure, narrow its range, or close both handles on the exact number. The estimate above then follows your figures instead of ours. Tap a figure to type it exactly.

volume.label: Machines you deliver in a year
volume.caption: Optional. Type your volume and every dollar figure on this page scales to your year. Leave it empty and the model stays per ten machines.

sliders.label: Machines that absorb one unbilled engineering loop
Months a fixed quote stands between signature and shipment

presets.label: We buy steel the day we quote

constants.text: Steel mill products rose 25.1 percent from September 2025 to August 2026 [[BENCHMARK]], BLS series WPU1017. This one is not a slider.
constants.note: When the October 15 update lands, this page's number changes with it, whichever direction it moves.

model.formulaText: Leak per 10 machines = 10 × absorbing share × loop cost + 10 × machine value × materials share × 0.251 × (months / 12)
model.plainText: In words, the machines that absorb one unbilled engineering loop at its cost, plus the slice of this year's steel rise a fixed quote absorbs while it stands between signature and shipment.
model.callout: One-of-a-kind machines leak between runoff and shipment. Nobody prices the debug days that make a first-of-its-kind machine behave, and nobody counts the calendar a build waits at design reviews, buyoffs, and customer furnished parts. Those numbers exist in your job records, unread.

respect.heading: What you already show in the open
paragraphs: Since 1989, formerly as A&A Metal Products, you renamed the company to match what it became [[OBSERVED]].
Machine designers, mechanical engineers, controls engineers, and programmers work under one 30,000 square foot roof with a fifteen ton crane [[OBSERVED]].
This year your shop delivered 100 ton and 350 ton press systems for a global railcar builder, by your own account [[OBSERVED]].
A customer you publish wrote: I wish we had 100 suppliers like A&A [[OBSERVED]].

proposal.promise: If your records show our printed range overstated your exposure, our findings letter says so in those words.

sources: BLS producer price index, steel mill products, series WPU1017, September 2025 to August 2026, pulled September 27, 2026; next release October 15, 2026.
